state.question: Five coherent monochromatic waves have the same polarization and equal individual intensity I. At a point their phases are 0,pi/5,2*pi/5,3*pi/5,4*pi/5. What is the observed intensity divided by the intensity when all five phases are equal?
state.notation: pi is the circle constant; i is the imaginary unit; ln is natural logarithm; sqrt is the nonnegative square root; c is light speed; hbar is reduced Planck constant. * denotes multiplication and ^ a power.
